rationale: Ming's work on universal zero-knowledge virtual machines and programmable trust aligns naturally with Tuan's mission to accelerate climate solutions through AI and geospatial intelligence — both are building foundational infrastructure (cryptographic and computational) to enable trust and verification across complex systems. While Ming focuses on ZK as an interoperability layer for blockchain and decentralized systems, and Tuan applies ML and geospatial data to energy optimization, they share a conviction that architecture and design thinking shape technology outcomes, and both have deep software engineering backgrounds (Rust/Go/Python and Python/TensorFlow respectively) that could spark interesting conversations about verifiable computation in high-stakes domains like renewable energy.
intro_message: Ming Guo, meet Tuan Van Doan — you're both building foundational infrastructure (cryptographic verification and AI-powered geospatial systems) to enable trust and solve critical problems; Tuan's work in climate tech and renewable energy could benefit from the kind of verifiable computation Ming is pioneering at ZKM.
